Commentary.Commentary: Once again, the Indian spinners were clinical. A combined figures of 8-0-38-4 between Washington Sundar and Yuzvendra Chahal drives home the point. Although Shardul Thakur and Vijay Shankar were good in patches, they didn't have answers to the onslaught at the end. The chase should be an interesting one, given the track doesn't seem too difficult to bat. Join us for it, that gets underway soon...

56 runs off the last 5 overs! Even though they kept losing wickets, these figures should help Bangladesh a great deal. Riding on Sabbir Rahman's sensible innings coupled with some useful cameos from Mahmudullah and Mehidy Hasan, they have succeeded in posting a total that, if not a winning one, is at least a challenging one. Interestingly, at one stage it looked as if they wouldn't even last their quota of overs.
On a length on off, pushed with soft hands towards wide long off. Gets a couple as a result. 18 runs off the last over. Momentum? Bangladesh. 167 IS INDIA'S TARGET TO WIN THE FINAL!
This is driven through covers for a couple. Good batting.
FOUR! Hasan is a handy batter and he is showing his skills here. Sees this delivered full outside off, he slices it through the gap between short third man and backward point for a boundary.
Full outside off, squeezed out towards point.

SIX! Ho, ho, ho! Mehidy Hasan is out to have fun there. But it looked to be a no ball for being over waist height. He comes down the track and smites it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. He is seen asking the umpire for a no ball, which isn't given. It's the correct decision as he had come down the track.
FOUR! A knuckle ball on a length outside off, Hasan moves across and ramps it over short fine leg for a boundary. Good start for Bangladesh to the last over.
This ball outside off, is kept out towards covers. Good end from the bowler.
Another one on off, pushed towards mid off for nothing.
Full on off, driven to mid off.
Mustafizur Rahman walks in at no. 10 for Bangladesh.

OUT! Timber! Clever from Unadkat. He delivers a length ball but rolls his fingers over it before letting it go. Hossain fails to read the change in pace and looks to play the pull over mid-wicket. Is through with the shot much before the ball arrives only to see his stumps shattered. An angry expression from Jaydev shows his frustration.
WIDE! Poor from Jaydev. He bangs it short and the ball goes well over Hossain, who misses his attempted pull.
Rubel Hossain is the next batter.
OUT! Why go for DRS when you can clean him up! Full and straight in line of the stumps, Rahman goes for the agricultural slog. Misses and finds his stumps disturbed. He departs after a decent knock.

INSIDE EDGE SAVES RAHMAN! He looks to play the paddle and seems to have missed it on the first look. The ball rolls through backward square leg for a brace. Leg byes are signaled by the umpire. Now, India opt for the review for LBW. On the replays it is seen that he got a massive inside edge there. Hence, the leg byes are cancelled and the runs are awarded to the batter. Meanwhile, India now lose their sole review.
Another LBW review is taken by India. Again Rahman is the man in question. Impact and height can come into play...
Jaydev Unadkat to bowl the penultimate over of the innings.
Short ball, pulled away through square leg for one. 11 runs off this one.
FOUR! This is good batting. Now Rahman moves across and paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Deft. Rahman guides this length ball past short third man for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Never looked out. Full ball on the pads, Sabbir misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball goes to the off side. Unaware, he comes down in search of a run only to retreat. After putting in an appeal, Shardul runs to the ball, takes it and has a underarm shy at the stumps at the batter's end but misses. Would have been curtains if he'd hit. Now the DRS is taken by India for LBW. It is seen that the ball first hit the front pad and then went onto the back one. Hawk Eye returns umpire's call. India's review is saved.
Almost unnoticedly, a review for LBW against Rahman is taken upstairs by India. Doesn't look to be close in the first view.

This is pushed towards point and a single is attempted. Dhawan the fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. The ball rolls all the way towards deep mid-wicket. Only a run is taken as a result.
On a length around middle and leg, flicked away through wide mid on for a single.
Shardul Thakur to bowl his penultimate over.
This is punched through covers for a single.
Mehidy Hasan is the next man in.
OUT! Shakib has to depart.
It is all happening now! A run out appeal against Shakib Al Hasan is taken upstairs.
A paddle in front of the stumps. The ball strikes the bat, then the helmet and then lands towards mid-wicket. A run taken.

SIX! Vijay is losing it here. Perhaps the ball is wet and he is unable to grip it well. Or maybe his slower ball attempts are going awry. He needs to keep it away tonight. He dishes out a juicy full toss to a batter batting over 50. Rahman accepts it and deposits it over deep mid-wicket. Just manages to clear a leaping man there.
Very full on the stumps, dug back towards the bowler.
SIX! Now Shankar is overdoing his slow ball stuff. Delivers it full outside off, Rahman waits for it and treats it like a spinner's delivery. Banishes it over deep mid-wicket for another biggie.
Rahman drives this full floated ball to long on to take strike on the first ball of the next over. 4-0-20-1 for Sundar tonight.
Shakib turns this one through mid-wicket to get to the other end.
Flatter outside off, cut away to point.
4th T20I FIFTY FOR RAHMAN! He has done well to be in the middle, even with wickets falling at the other end. Pushes this through mid off for a single that gets him to the milestone.
SIX! Beauty! Floated outside off, Rahman gets down on a knee and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen. Moves to 49 now.
Floated around middle, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Last over for Washington Sundar.
This one is tapped to the off side and a quick run is taken.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
FOUR! Lucky. Full toss outside off, Shakib plays the drive but gets an outside edge. The ball goes to the third man fence in a flash.
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Skipper Shakib Al Hasan walks out at number 7. Can he provide the final impetus for Bangladesh?

OUT! Comedy of errors ends in a tragedy for Mahmudullah and Bangladesh! Let's take it step by step. Shankar delivers a slow leg cutter on off, Mahmudullah gets deceived and is early into the flick. Seems to have gone off the pads. The ball rolls towards the right of the keeper and the Indians appeal. Rahman meanwhile comes down in search of a run. Karthik is alive to the occasion but has a shy at his end, which is a mistake. In this case, fortunately for him, he misses the stumps and Shankar dives to his right while backing it up. Mahmudullah at this point has responded positively to his partner's call but then stops in the middle. That's not all. Seeing Vijay fumble, he proceeds to take the run. But the bowler recovers well and runs to disturb the stumps at his end. Now the batter is nowhere near as he has given up. Mahmudullah has been involved in 18 run outs and has run out his partner 10 times out of that. Bad.
FOUR! Poor ball. Bowls it full on the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it away through fine leg for a boundary.
Vijay Shankar to bowl his third over now.
This delivery is pushed towards mid on for a single. Decent over from Thakur this.

Lovely bowling. Shardul has shown a tendency to blow hot and cold in the series so far. Tonight's one of his better one. Lets this one go on a length outside off, Mahmudullah has a feel for it but misses.
Another knuckle ball outside off, Sabbir lets it come to him before tapping it to the off side for a single.
A low full toss outside off, Rahman is a touch early into his shot. Gets an outside edge and the ball goes on the bounce to the keeper. Knuckle ball.
FOUR! Authoritative! Full length ball on off, Rahman clears his front leg and hits it over the bowler's head for a boundary.

FOUR! Not a good effort from Chahal. On a length around middle and off, Rahman tries to be cute. Gets out the paddle and just makes enough contact. Chahal at short fine leg puts in the dive but does so over the ball. It then has enough to trickle away to the fence.
Shardul Thakur is brought back for another spell.
Rahman taps this length ball towards cover-point and retains strike.

Close! Mahmudullah would have been on his way back if that would have hit. He taps it towards mid on and sets off. Jaydev gets to the ball, turns and has a shy at the bowler's end even as he loses his balance. Misses the stumps even as Mahmudullah dives and gets a run added.

FOUR! Top quality shot alright, but this has been Unadkat's problem this series. He has given far too many boundary balls. Lands it on a length outside off, Mahmudullah just gives it direction. Finds the gap between backward point and short third man and accepts the result that follows.
On a length on the stumps, blocked from the crease.
This one is slanted in on the pads, clipped away through backward square leg for one.
Unadkat comes round the wicket and lands it outside off. Mahmudullah guides it to third man to get to the other end.
Jaydev Unadkat is back into the attack.
Short ball around off and middle, pulled away towards deep mid-wicket for one. 10 runs off the over, without much risks taken.
Hit aerially on the bounce to deep mid-wicket for one more.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. One run added to the total.
Length ball on the pads, nudged away through square leg for a couple
WIDE! Slower one but down the leg side. Mahmudullah misses the flick.
Bharat Arun had a quick chat on the sidelines. He says that Sundar has a good calm head and that shows in his game. Praises the bowler's effort in the Powerplay.

Suresh Raina. The way he throws himself on the field is a joy to watch. Again this one is hit wide of long on by charging down the track by Mahmudullah. Raina covers good ground to his right from long on, dives and keeps it down to two.
A touch short in length, Mahmudullah has a shimmy down the track and hits it aerially towards mid-wicket. Gets a brace as a result.
Vijay Shankar is back on.
Shortish and spinning away, Mahmudullah goes back and slaps it through covers for one. On 18th March, Chahal has finished with 18/3!
Blocked towards the on side. Chahal himself gets to the ball. Seeing this, Rahman, who wanted a run has to get back hurriedly.
This one is swept away to rotate strike.
Another googly, not picked up! This is served around off, Mahmudullah looks to play for the conventional turn but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for one.
A touch shorter, pulled through square leg for a single.
Mahmudullah walks in with his side not having any momentum with it.

OUT! That's all from Rahim in this series. The spinner's bait is too hard to resist and he pays the price. Chahal floats it outside off, Rahim charges down the track with some movement away. Goes with the attempted smash over covers and ends up getting it off the top edge. Shankar covers some ground in the circle to his right and takes a good diving catch. On another look, it is seen that it was the googly that Mushfiqur didn't pick.
Slower one, Rahman comes down the track but hits it back to Sundar.
Fuller in length, Rahim plays it towards mid on for one.
Rahim has punched this ball to covers.
Rahman gets one for his reverse sweep this time near the backward point region.
Short ball, Rahman rocks back and pulls it away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Outside off, Rahim cuts it to backward point and quickly moves to the other end.
Washington Sundar comes back into the attack.
Flighted ball outside off, Rahim pushes it to covers to rotate strike well.
Tosses this up, Rahman sweeps and gets one towards mid-wicket.
Quicker one on the pads of Rahman. He misses his flick and the ball hits him on the pads.
Outside off, Rahman cuts this to point.
Around off, Rahim sweeps this to the short fine leg fielder. A good stop by Shankar but they still manage to take a run.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Rahman guides this to the short third man fielder, Dhawan. The fielder has a shy at the stumps at the striker's end but misses. Shankar himself runs to his right to back it up, but slips and lets it through. They get a run on the overthrow. 14 runs off this over.
Drags his length back, Rahim pulls this towards mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Clever. Knew that Vijay will pitch it up and premeditates this. Length ball around off, Rahman cutely flicks this over short fine leg for a boundary.
SIX! Short ball and pulled away handsomely. Rahman  comes down the track and plays the horizontal bat shot. He is well in control of that and smokes it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Rahim hits this through mid on and moves to the other end.
Vijay Shankar comes in for his first over.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flatter ball this time, Rahman pulls it away but for just one.
Rahim fetches for this outside off and sweeps it on the leg for one.
Short ball, Rahman pushes this towards mid on for a run.
Another reverse sweep, again straight to the short third man fielder.
Played to the point region by the Rahim. They pick up a single.

Low full toss, Rahman misses his flick. The Indians appeal but to no avail. Thakur thinks that he has got him LBW but Karthik tells him that there was bat involved. After a word with his skipper, they don't take it upstairs. 40/3 in the Powerplay for Bangladesh.
Wide. The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Short again, Rahman pulls this towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
FOUR! Cannot set a field for that. Bangs this short Rahman goes for the pull but gets a top edge. The ball flies over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Rahman flicks it away with a wristy shot. A slight hesitation and then they decide against the run.

Behind that good length again on the pads of Rahim who misses his flick. The ball hits him high on the pads and rolls towards square leg as they steal a leg bye. Shardul appeals but does not get an support from his players.
Back of a length ball, Rahman doesn't want Thakur to settle and comes down the pitch. Doesn't connect well enough as he hits this to deep square leg off the inner half for one.
Here he is! After a wonderful catch in the previous over, Shardul Thakur is now brought on to bowl.
Wicketkeeper batsman Mushfiqur Rahim makes his way out at no. 5. He is in decent form in this tourney and should look to bail his side out of trouble.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! India are getting over Bangladesh like a rash. Loopy delivery around middle and leg, Sarkar thinks it okay to get down and sweep it over backward square leg and get some runs in the form of a boundary. Executes the shot but finds Dhawan at that position to perfection. 'Gabbar' takes the offering and thumps his thigh in celebration. Bangladesh slide further. Praky, my mate here, states that all these signs point to a sub-100 score for them.
Slower through the air, Sabbir tries to sweep. Misses and the ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
FOUR! Shot! Loopy delivery in line of the stumps, Rahman gets down on one knee and blasts it over mid-wicket for a boundary. He has the ability, it's time to realise it now.
Floated around middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
Soumya Sarkar walks in next. He needs to spend some time in the middle.

OUT! Whatttaaaaa catch! Shardul Thakur, you little beauty! He has pulled off an amazingly controlled catch on the long on fence. Seeing the tossed up delivery on the stumps, Tamim charges down the track to banish it out of the ground. But he ends up getting more height than distance. It seems as if it just has enough to clear long on, but no. Thakur there judges it and catches it with a leap. After that he keeps his balance to not go beyond the ropes. It is taken upstairs for a confirmation. Shardul seems to have done well as the TV umpire is happy after having multiple looks at the replays. Bangladesh lose two inside the Powerplay.
GONE??? Shardul Thakur seems to have taken a stunner... As is the case with such catches, the umpires take another look. Looks to be gone for all money, does Tamim Iqbal.
Floated around middle and leg, swept straight to backward square leg.
Yuzvendra Chahal comes in to roll his arm.
Outside off, Rahman pushes it to covers. End of a very good over for India, just one run and a wicket from it.
Rahman strides forward and is happy to block it.
OHHH!!! Straighter one, outside off, Rahman gets beaten in his defense and Karthik collects it well.
First ball and Rahman tries to reverse sweep it. Connects it but hits it to the short third man fielder for a dot.
Sabbir Rahman is the next man in.

OUT! An early blow for Bangladesh and the fast scoring Liton Das falls to Washington Sundar. That's another wicket for Sundar in the Powerplay. Not afraid to toss it up and gets his man. Simple off spinning ball around off, Das goes for the sweep, gets a top edge to it and the ball skies in the air towards backward square leg. As the shouts of 'caaatttccchhh ittt' follow, Raina settles under it and takes a good catch. Just the start the Indians wanted.
Delicate glance by Tamim through the fine leg region. One run added to the total.
Slower one, Tamim plays it with soft hands on the leg side and will retain strike for the next over.
On the pads of Das, who flicks it towards square leg for one more.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Follows it up by hitting it towards mid on for one. Sensible.
SIX! Excellent foot work. Around off, Das charges down and lofts this over deep point for a biggie. Lovely shot.
Overpitched ball, Tamim flicks it away through mid-wicket. Pandey runs from deep square leg to his right, then throws himself to save the boundary and does well to stop a run.
Quicker full ball, Das hits it back to Sundar.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Short ball, Tamim pulls this through mid-wicket and will get couple for it. Good work from Rahul in the deep.
Strong appeal, but nothing from the umpire. Darts this quick around off, Tamim goes for the block but the ball hits the front pad. The Indians appeal but bail out pretty soon.
Tamim hits this to the mid on fielder.
Starts by bowling a flat ball in line of the stumps, Das works it towards mid on for a run
Washington Sundar will bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Boundary to end the over. Length ball on the pads of Tamim who flicks it away over the short fine leg fielder. The ball goes over him and rolls away to the fence for the first boundary of the final.
Similar ball, Linton flicks it away to square leg for one more.
On the pads, Tamim works it around the corner for one.
Das opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide. First extras. Way down the leg, and gives the umpire some early stretch.
Bowls this on a good length around that fourth stump line. Das gets behind the ball and defends it.
Comes charging in and serves this on a back of a length spot on middle and leg, Tamim tucks it to mid-wicket and gets off the mark.
The Bangladesh opening pair of Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das make their way out to bat. Jaydev Unadkat will have the new ball. A slip in place. Here we go...
The players are out for their respective national anthems. It will be Bangladesh's first. Start of play is moments away now.

Shakib Al Hasan feels that it is not a bad thing to bat first. He reckons that the pitch will remain same in the entire game like it has been throughout the tournament. He continues saying that his nerves are in control and the players are focused. Opines that they will have to play better to beat India today. States that they are going in with an unchanged side.

Rohit Sharma feels that the track is good but states that the wicket looks a bit dry. Adds that it will get better. He suggests that they will look to bowl well and then chase down the score. States that throughout the tournament the teams that have chased have won. Ends confirming one change to the XI - Jaydev Unadkat comes in for Mohammed Siraj.
Toss - Rohit Sharma spins the coin, Shakib Al Hasan calls tails and heads it is. India will bowl first.

PITCH REPORT - Brett Lee exclaims that it is a brand new wicket, with no visible bald patches there. Reckons it to be a hard surface and should be pretty good for batting. Adds further that it could take some turn as the game progresses. States that the knuckle ball and slower ones should come into play as well. Opines that anything around 190 should be a good score.

India on the other hand, have bounced back well after a loss in the first game. Their top order has stepped up in every game and the inexperienced bowlers have shown great maturity. They start as favorites and Rohit will hope the result follows the same way. Let's wait and watch to see who the home crowd supports! Rain was forecast today but let's hope the weather stays as good as it is now.

So, Sri Lanka have not been invited to their own party. But the guests - Bangladesh and India, without a host will not shy away from having a ball. Who would have put their money on Bangladesh to reach the finals? The ones who don't play fantasy leagues! Taking nothing away from the Tigers, they have played well and have beaten the hosts twice to get here. They have not played in the same way against today's opponents. But it's a new day and they will ride high after a stunning last-over finish couple of days back.
